subject: craft
angle: Craft paper texture under a thumb
caption:
The card sits on the table for a week before anyone opens it properly.

Then someone runs a thumb along the edge and stops. That is the part we spend the most time on, and the part nobody photographs. It is also the part that decides whether the card gets kept or thrown.

Send us your motif and we will show you the paper that suits it.
